description: This Java interface defines a 'LogEntry' that represents a connection log entry. It includes methods to access various log attributes such as correlation ID, timestamp, category, type, level, message, address, and associated Thing ID. The interface also provides JSON serialization capabilities and contains a nested class defining the relevant JSON fields.

classes.name: LogEntry.JsonFields
classes.description: A nested class defining constants for JSON fields used in serializing and deserializing LogEntry instances.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID associated with the log entry.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the log entry was created.

methods.name: getLogCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the log entry.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the address if available.

methods.name: getThingId
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the associated ThingId if available.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the LogEntry to a JSON object including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the LogEntry to a JSON object based on schema version and field selector.
